summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (39 passed, run with the prepared venv). Not verified: mypy, ruff, black, and isort are not installed in the venv and were not installed, so the type-check gate, lint, format, and type-ignore placement are unchecked; line lengths were checked by hand (all within 88). Nothing was committed. Design note: core SequencePath and AlternativePath flatten nested instances of their own type, so nested forms of the same kind come out flattened; tests compare against operator-built expectations, which flatten the same way. Tests omit None and plain-string inputs, since the spec's test requirements don't list them.
